arcade.description: Unknown, may be unlocked by default

candidate_lines: ** It received a GRAVITY chart on June 9th, 2016, which can be purchased in the SDVX Station.
* ツーマンライブ was added to BeatStream on March 5th, 2015. Its MEDIUM and BEAST charts could be unlocked via the Mei mail ''Watashi ni mo sore kurai iru wa.'' in ''Takahashi-san Lab.''.
** As of December 3rd, 2015, these charts have been unlocked by default.
** In pop'n music ラピストリア, it could be unlocked by playing seven ひなビタ♪ songs.

** In REFLEC BEAT groovin'!! Upper and [[AC RB VOLZZA|REFLEC BEAT VOLZZA]], it could be unlocked by playing any 日向美ビタースイーツ♪ song (save for [[Kimochi connect|キモチコネクト]] and [[Mirai prism|ミライプリズム(collaboration ver.)]]) using the 東雲夏陽 icon, which is acquired by playing [[Suigetsukyouka no connotation|水月鏡花のコノテーション]] five times.
* ツーマンライブ received a NIGHTMARE chart in [[AC BST AnimTribe|BeatStream アニムトライヴ]] on June 9th, 2016, unlockable via ''BEAST HACKER''.
* ツーマンライブ [ 2 ] is one of the unlocks of [[AC jb festo|jubeat festo]]'s ''T-emo STORE''. It could be purchased with 100 T-emo from January 7th to February 4th, 2019.
** It could be purchased again with 50 T-emo from February 3rd to March 2nd, 2020.
** In [[AC jb Ave.|jubeat Ave.]] and [[AC jb beyond the Ave.|beyond the Ave.]], it is one of the CONCIERGE unlocks of the ''LIGHT CHAT'' unlocking system from August 17th, 2022.

candidate_lines: * チョコレートスマイル received a NIGHTMARE chart in [[AC BST AnimTribe|BeatStream アニムトライヴ]] on June 9th, 2016, unlockable via ''BEAST HACKER''.
* チョコレートスマイル was one of the unlocks of ノスタルジア FORTE's [[MISSION BINGO]] unlocking system. It can be unlocked from December 21st, 2017 by playing [[Luminous days|ルミナスデイズ]].
* チョコレートスマイル received UPPER charts as one of the unlocks of [[AC pnm UniLab|pop'n music UniLab]]'s ''Kakusei no Elem'' (覚醒のエルム) unlocking system. They can be unlocked from July 4th, 2024.
** In [[AC pnm Jam&Fizz|pop'n music Jam&Fizz]], these charts can be unlocked in the ''Kakusei no Elem Puchi'' (覚醒のエルム プチ) event from August 28th, 2025.

* チョコレートスマイル received an INFLUENCE chart as part of ポラリスコード's ''SHIBA TV no summer vacation'' (シバテレビのサマーバケーション) event. It could be unlocked from July 25th to September 9th, 2024, from December 18th, 2024 to January 22nd, 2025, and from July 10th to August 17th, 2025.

candidate_lines: * Plan 8 is the ONE MORE EXTRA STAGE song of the ''LEGEND CROSS'' event in beatmania IIDX 20 tricoro. To unlock it, you must EX-HARD Clear [[Thor's Hammer]] with a AAA rank to access this song.
** In [[AC SPADA|beatmania IIDX 21 SPADA]], its NORMAL, HYPER, and ANOTHER charts can be unlocked by obtaining 52, 60, and 68 Tran Medals respectively.
** As of December 19th, 2013, it is unlocked by default.
* Plan 8 could be unlocked from February 27th, 2013 to March 3rd, 2014 in jubeat saucer as part of the [[Cafe de Tran|Café de Tran]] unlock system. It was the sixth unlockable song for that game.
** In [[AC jb saucer fulfill|jubeat saucer fulfill]], it can be unlocked as part of ''saucer macchiato'''s Side Menu from May 1st, 2014.
** In [[AC jb prop|jubeat prop]], it can be unlocked by playing it as a BONUS TUNE from May 28th, 2015.
** In [[AC jb Qubell|jubeat Qubell]], it is one of the Garnet unlocks of the ''dig dig Qubell'' unlocking system.

candidate_lines: * 紅焔 was the winner of the つぎドカ! event, and later appeared as one of jubeat saucer's ''Only Now Songs'' (いまだけ楽曲). It could be unlocked from January 9th to February 1st, 2013.
** From February 2nd, 2013, it could be unlocked via ''bistro saucer''.
** In [[AC jb saucer fulfill|jubeat saucer fulfill]], it can be unlocked as part of ''saucer macchiato'''s Side Menu from April 23rd, 2014.
** In [[AC jb prop|jubeat prop]], it is part of the ''Step'' unlocking system, unlockable by reaching Step Level 99.

* A 3P palette for RETSU is available by inputting the code found on the ''pop'n music Sunny Park original soundtrack vol.2'' album. The code must be inputted at the final e-AMUSEMENT screen, where your already unlocked Secret Characters are shown.

* 紅焔 received a SPECIAL chart in [[AC RB groovin'!!|REFLEC BEAT groovin'!!]] on August 22nd, 2014. It could be purchased at the REFLEC Shop for 1500 Refle, after clearing the chart in the FINAL ROUND of the Hot Test (アツい検定) added on the same day.
** From October 30th, 2014, it could be purchased without prerequisites.
** In [[AC RB VOLZZA|REFLEC BEAT VOLZZA]], it could be purchased from the Garage for 8 VOLZZA KEYs.

** In [[AC RB VOLZZA 2|REFLEC BEAT VOLZZA 2]], it could be unlocked by clearing its HARD chart a specific number of times, depending on the grade obtained on it (AAA+: 1 time, AAA: 2 times, AA: 3 times, A or lower: 5 times).
* 紅焔 is one of the unlocks of the [[pop'n & BEMANI Cheers x Cheers!!|pop'n & BEMANI Cheers × Cheers!!]] event. It could be unlocked in SOUND VOLTEX ∇ from January 22nd to February 23rd, 2026.

candidate_lines: * In [[CS GFDM V|GuitarFreaks V & DrumMania V CS]], Homesick Pt.2&3 may be automatically unlocked for play in Standard Mode by having memory card save data from [[CS pnm 12|pop'n music 12 いろは CS]]. Homesick Pt.2&3 may also be unlocked by turning on time-released unlocks and playing the game for 30.5 hours; note there are no means to obtain the song through GITADO SLOT.

* Homesick Pt.2&3 (SOFT ROCK LONG) received a brand-new EX chart in pop'n music peace, as part of the ''pop'n time trip'' (ポップンタイムトリップ) event. This chart could be unlocked from May 23rd, 2019 to February 19th, 2020 by filling out 1 stamp of the first pop'n music 5 card.

* Homesick Pt.2&3 (Nostalgia Edition) is one of the unlocks of ノスタルジア Op.3's ''Goudou ongaku-sai pop'n music selection'' (合同音楽祭 pop'n music セレクション) event. It could be unlocked from September 29th to November 17th, 2022.
** It can be unlocked again from March 16th to April 26th, 2023, from November 2nd to December 21st, 2023, and from September 26th, 2024 onwards.
* Homesick Pt.2&3 is one of the POP-KUN FROM pop'n-01 unlocks of jubeat beyond the Ave.'s ''LIGHT CHAT'' unlocking system. It could be unlocked from February 28th to March 19th, 2024.
** Since May 1st, 2026, it can be unlocked by playing it thrice as a BONUS TUNE.
